## Pointer: the chemistry step at the pin (`MeshBlockImpl::set_chemistry`) {#sec-ch10-kinetics}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@0d5caacbd8e365c87a30af6ce043c39ab30c0959 (UCzhangxi/snapy v3/final)
sources: STRUCTURE.md section 3 (old 10's chemistry material goes to 11 and E); src/mesh/meshblock.{hpp,cpp}; src/mesh/stage_executor.cpp; examples/run_hydro.cpp, all at the pin
status: draft
-->

The chemistry kinetics was a section of the pre-V3 chapter of this number. In the V3 outline its slot in the stage
belongs to chapter 11 (execution) and its kintera contract to @sec-appe. Neither is rewritten yet, so this pointer
keeps the references into it resolving and states only where the code is at the pin. It is not a scheme section and
derives nothing.

At the pin the kinetics is no longer a driver's call between steps. A caller registers the reactions on the block
with `set_chemistry`, which needs an equation of state with a thermo and builds the block's chemistry source
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::set_chemistry >}}). The step then runs it after the last stage
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.hpp MeshBlockImpl::set_chemistry >}}). The stage executor gives it its own slot, on a
bare block and on a Mesh's block alike
({{< code src/mesh/stage_executor.cpp StageExecutor::chemistry_slot >}}). The example driver registers it this way
({{< code examples/run_hydro.cpp main >}}). At the pin the chemistry step adds its species increment to the state
and posts nothing to the register; the code's comment says its register posts are still to come
({{< code src/chemistry/chemistry_source.cpp ChemistrySource::forward >}}).
